facts.fact: The FBI calls your own federal record an 'Identity History Summary' (often called a rap sheet). It lists information taken from fingerprint submissions kept by the FBI, related to arrests and, in some instances, federal employment, naturalization or military service. For arrests it shows the agency that submitted fingerprints, date of arrest, charge, and disposition if known.

Who can request: the subject of the record (you) may request a copy of your own Identity History Summary to review it or to obtain a change, correction or update. Rules come from DOJ Order 556-73 ('Departmental Order') and 28 CFR 16.30-16.34. You can also get proof that no record exists.
28 CFR 16.30: the subpart covers procedures when the subject of an identification record requests production of that record to review it or to obtain a change, correction, or updating of that record.

Fingerprints are required. 28 CFR 16.32: the request must include proof of identity consisting of name, date and place of birth and a set of rolled-inked fingerprint impressions on standard fingerprint cards. The FBI record check is fingerprint-based, not name-based.

Fee: $18. The current FBI request form (I-783, Rev. 03/19/2025) says to mail the signed request form, fingerprint card, and payment of $18 U.S. dollars. 28 CFR 16.33 also sets an $18 fee by certified check or money order payable to the Treasury of the United States.
Fee waiver: 28 CFR 16.33 says any request for waiver of the fee must accompany the original request and include a claim and proof of indigency.

By mail: send the signed request form (I-783), a fingerprint card, and $18 (certified check, money order, or the FBI credit card payment form) to FBI CJIS Division - Summary Request, 1000 Custer Hollow Road, Clarksburg, West Virginia 26306.

Online: the FBI's Electronic Departmental Order (eDO) system at edo.cjis.gov lets you request your Identity History Summary (or proof none exists) and challenge it online. The request, payment and response are electronic, but unless you are fingerprinted at a participating post office you must still mail a hardcopy fingerprint card.

Post office fingerprinting: electronic requesters can have fingerprints scanned at a participating U.S. Post Office; additional fees may apply (FBI FAQ, per search snippet; page itself blocked to automated fetch).

Through an FBI-approved channeler: private companies under contract with the FBI collect fingerprints and the fee, forward the request electronically, and return results. Channelers charge their own fees on top of the FBI fee. The FBI publishes the list of approved channelers for Departmental Order submissions.
Same fee by mail or electronic: the FBI FAQ says the $18 fee is the same whether you request by mail or electronically (per search snippet of the FAQ page).

How long: the FBI said eDO (launched February 2, 2018) reduced response times from more than 100 days to less than a week including mailing time; fingerprints scanned at participating post offices could get responses in under 24 hours. This is from a 2019 FBI article; the current processing-time estimate on fbi.gov could not be retrieved (page blocks automated access), so tell readers to check fbi.gov for current times.

This is not a full national background check: the FBI form says the summary may not include information from state repositories that would show up on an employment background check. Check your state record too.

Challenging an error: 28 CFR 16.34 says you should apply directly to the agency that contributed the questioned information, or send the challenge to the FBI CJIS Division (1000 Custer Hollow Road, Clarksburg, WV 26306), which forwards it to the contributing agency. The FBI changes the record only after receiving an official communication from that contributing agency.

Challenging online via eDO: you must provide your FBI Universal Control Number (FBI Number) from your Identity History Summary, or your State Identification Number (SID) plus the two-letter state abbreviation where the offense occurred. The FBI cannot modify information unless the agency that owns it tells it to.

states.agency: Alaska Department of Public Safety, Criminal Records and Identification (R&I) Bureau
states.check_name: Request for Criminal Justice Information (from record subject)
states.how: Name-based: mail the completed name-based form with check or money order to R&I Bureau (5700 E. Tudor Road, Anchorage, AK 99507), appear in person at a walk-in location, or request online. Fingerprint-based: mail a full FD-258 ten-print card with a letter and money order.
states.notes: DPS: 'The subject of a record is authorized to view or purchase a copy of his/her entire record.' Name-based check $20; fingerprint-based check $35 (Alaska records only); state + national fingerprint check $47. Extra copies $5 if requested at the same time. DPS recommends fingerprint-based checks because name searches may miss records under aliases. Error-correction process not described on the page.

states.agency: Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA), State Bureau of Investigation, Criminal Records and Identification Unit
states.check_name: Application to Review/Challenge Alabama Criminal History Record Information (CHRI) - ALEA CJIS Form 46
states.how: Mail (or walk-in/hand-deliver) the completed Form 46, signed by you and two witnesses OR notarized, with a set of your own fingerprints taken by an authorized law enforcement agency on an FBI 'Applicant' card (FD-258), and the fee by money order or cashier's check.
states.notes: Form says 'PERSONAL REQUESTS ONLY: The required $25.00 administrative fee' by money order or cashier's check. Processing is about 5-10 business days per ALEA; challenges take longer. The same Form 46 has a separate Challenge section (not for expungements); a challenge must list the charge and date of each arrest/disposition challenged. Ala. Admin. Code 265-X-2-.03 requires a challenge within one calendar year of ALEA's response to your review application.

states.agency: Arkansas State Police (ASP), Identification Bureau
states.check_name: Arkansas State criminal background check (Form ASP-122 / online CBC system)
states.how: Online through the state's Criminal Background Check system (cbc.ark.org, account with Tyler Arkansas), or by mail/in person with Form ASP-122 signed by the subject, a $25 check or money order to Arkansas State Police, and a stamped addressed envelope, to ASP Identification Bureau, 1 State Police Plaza Drive, Little Rock, AR 72209.
states.notes: Mail/in-person: $25. Online: $22 per Arkansas name-based check plus an annual account fee charged by Tyler Arkansas. Processing 2-5 business days after receipt. It is a name query of a fingerprint-linked database. Errors: if an arrest isn't yours, you can be fingerprinted by law enforcement for comparison; if not yours it is removed at no charge. Some form versions require notarization.

states.agency: Arizona Department of Public Safety (AZDPS), Central State Repository
states.check_name: Record Review (Record Review Packet)
states.how: Download the Record Review Packet (or call 602-223-2000), get fingerprinted by an official at a law enforcement agency on the card marked 'RECORD REVIEW', complete the contact information sheet, and mail to AZDPS Central State Repository Section, P.O. Box 18450, Mail Drop 3110, Phoenix, AZ 85005-8450.
states.notes: The official Record Review Packet and DPS page list no DPS fee for a record review (could not confirm the amount as $0 on an official page; the fingerprinting agency may charge). Under A.R.S. 41-1750 the subject may review the record to check accuracy and completeness. Results mailed (or emailed) in about two weeks / within 15 days. DPS says a private citizen may 'review and/or challenge' the record; call 602-223-2000 for challenge steps.

states.agency: California Department of Justice (DOJ), Bureau of Criminal Identification and Analysis, Record Review & Challenge Section
states.check_name: Record Review (Requesting Your Own Criminal Records)
states.how: California residents: fill out Live Scan form BCIA 8016RR, check 'Record Review', and get Live Scan fingerprints at any public Live Scan site (police, sheriff, private). Out-of-state/outside US: mail FD-258 fingerprint card with the Application to Obtain Copy of State Summary of Criminal History and payment to CA DOJ, Record Review & Challenge Section, PO Box 160207, Sacramento, CA 95816-0207.
states.notes: DOJ: 'individuals must submit fingerprint images, pay a $25 processing fee to the DOJ'. Live Scan sites charge their own rolling fee. Fee waiver available ('Apply for a Fee Waiver' page) to cover DOJ processing fees. Challenges: use the 'Claim of Alleged Inaccuracy or Incompleteness' form (BCIA 8706) included with your response; mail it with a copy of your record and proof supporting the claim. Governed by Penal Code 11120-11127.

states.agency: Colorado Bureau of Investigation (CBI), Biometric Identification and Records Unit (BIRU)
states.check_name: Internet Criminal History Check (ICHC) / Criminal History Record Information (CHRI) request; fingerprint check via Colorado Applicant Background Service (CABS)
states.how: Name-based: online through the Internet Criminal History Check (ICHC), or a CHRI request processed by CBI staff (form, in person or by mail). Fingerprint-based: through a CABS vendor (IdentoGO or Colorado Fingerprinting).
states.notes: CBI fee page: ICHC $6.00 (name-based, online, cannot be notarized); CHRI staff-processed request $13.00 (notarized on request). Fingerprint check via CABS: CBI state fee roughly $16.50-$19.50 plus vendor surcharge (range shown on fee page). For a personal FBI check CBI points to the FBI IdHSC. Errors: dispute with the arresting agency or request a CBI record challenge - get your CHRI, then present it in person with photo ID; your fingerprints are taken and compared to the arrest record.

states.agency: Connecticut Department of Emergency Services and Public Protection (DESPP), State Police Bureau of Identification
states.check_name: Personal record search / State Criminal History Check (Form DPS-846-C)
states.how: By U.S. mail only (no email/fax): send the request form DPS-846-C with payment (check or money order to 'Treasurer-State of CT') to the State Police Bureau of Identification, 1111 Country Club Road, Middletown, CT 06457. Can be name-based, or fingerprint-supported with a full fingerprint card taken by a law enforcement agency.
states.notes: DESPP page lists '$75 for a State Criminal History Check', $15 fingerprinting fee if DESPP takes prints, and $13.25 for a federal check (federal only where authorized by statute). Page notes a rate change effective October 1, 2026 - verify the current amount. No fee waiver found. Correction process not described on this page.

states.agency: Metropolitan Police Department (MPD), Arrest and Criminal History Section
states.check_name: Police Clearance (PD Form 70); Option A arrest record for sealing/expungement eligibility
states.how: In person by appointment at 441 4th Street NW, Room 550 South, Washington, DC 20001 with ID (driver's license, non-driver ID, or original birth certificate AND Social Security card). By mail: send a notarized letter with full name, DOB, SSN, phone, email, copy of ID, self-addressed stamped envelope and $7 money order payable to DC Treasurer.
states.notes: Fee $7 (in person: cash or credit card only). Option A lists ALL adult arrests regardless of disposition - meant for checking eligibility for sealing/expungement or filing a sealing motion. Option B (any other purpose) shows convictions/forfeitures within 10 years. Processing up to 10 business days in person; mail allow six weeks. Must be 18+; you can only get information about yourself. This is a name/ID-based local check.

states.agency: Delaware State Police, State Bureau of Identification (SBI)
states.check_name: Personal Criminal History Report (service code 27RVGT)
states.how: Register online with the fingerprint vendor (IdentoGO) using service code 27RVGT and get fingerprinted at an IdentoGO site; results are issued only to the requesting citizen.
states.notes: DSP page lists $72.00 for a certified State of Delaware criminal history and $85.00 for state + federal, but does not state a separate fee for the personal report (27RVGT) - fee not confirmed. 11 Del. C. 8513 allows a person or their attorney to obtain a copy of their own Delaware criminal history record. Expungement application fee is $72. Questions: (302) 739-5884.

states.agency: Florida Department of Law Enforcement (FDLE), Criminal History Record Maintenance Section
states.check_name: Personal Review (and Challenge) of Florida criminal history record
states.how: Get fingerprinted on a card by a local law enforcement agency or approved vendor, complete the Personal Review application, and mail it with the fingerprint card to FDLE.
states.notes: Fla. Admin. Code R. 11C-8.001: 'FDLE shall not require payment of any fees' for the personal review; the subject pays any fee charged by the fingerprinting agency or vendor. Right granted by s. 943.056, F.S.; only the individual or their attorney may request, and the copy cannot be used for employment, licensing or immigration. Processing up to 30 working days. Challenges use the same Personal Review and Challenge form under Rule 11C-8.001 (with administrative review possible). Faster alternative: FDLE's name-based public search is $24 but is not a personal review. FDLE pages block automated fetch; fee confirmed via the administrative rule.

states.agency: Georgia Bureau of Investigation (GBI), Georgia Crime Information Center (GCIC)
states.check_name: Copy of your Georgia criminal history record (via local law enforcement); GCIC Record Inspection to challenge a record
states.how: GBI says you can obtain a copy of your Georgia record from most sheriff's offices or police departments (contact your local agency for its requirements). To inspect/challenge at GCIC: appointment at the GCIC Lobby Office (404-244-2639 option 1), or by mail with a signed written request describing the data challenged, two completed applicant fingerprint cards, and return address to GCIC, P.O. Box 370808, Decatur, GA 30037.
states.fingerprints: required for GCIC record inspection/challenge; local agency copy requirements vary
states.notes: Fee for a copy obtained through a local sheriff/police department is set locally and not stated by GBI. GCIC fee schedule (effective Jan 1, 2025): Record Inspection to challenge a criminal history record $10.00 if you already have fingerprint cards; $25.00 with fingerprinting at GBI Headquarters; record restriction (expungement) $25.00. GBI recommends reviewing your record before applying for record restriction and contacting the arresting agency/court if a disposition is missing.

states.agency: Hawaii Department of the Attorney General, Hawaii Criminal Justice Data Center (HCJDC)
states.check_name: Access & Review (form HCJDC-073)
states.how: In office by appointment only (call 808-587-3279) with fingerprinting done there, or by mail after being fingerprinted by your local law enforcement agency (call HCJDC for an Access and Review fingerprint packet). Name-based searches are separately available on the eCrim public site.
states.notes: HCJDC: Access & Review in-office service fee $55; by mail service fee $35 (plus any local fingerprinting fee). Turnaround 3-5 business days. No cash accepted in office; card payments carry a 3% fee. For personal use only. HCJDC FAQ: you have the right to access your record and challenge its completeness and accuracy through Access & Review. Separate 'Wrongful Use of Name/SSN' process ($55, refunded if misuse is verified).

states.agency: Iowa Department of Public Safety, Division of Criminal Investigation (DCI)
states.check_name: Iowa Criminal History Record Check
states.how: Online (Iowa Record Check Online), by mail, fax or email with the Request and Billing Forms, or in person at DCI (8:00-4:00 M-F) with state-issued photo ID for immediate results on yourself. Phone requests not accepted.
states.notes: DCI: 'The fee for an Iowa Criminal History Record Check through the DCI is $15 per last name.' Accepts cash, check, money order, card. All records are fingerprint-supported; DCI may request fingerprints to verify identity. Disputes: email DCI with details of the disputed information and DCI will review. Iowa Code 692.2 gives a person access to their own criminal history data.

states.agency: Idaho State Police, Bureau of Criminal Identification (BCI)
states.check_name: Name Based Criminal Background Check / Fingerprint Based Background Check (Idaho Central Repository)
states.how: Mail the Name Based Criminal Background Check Form (or Fingerprint Based form with a completed fingerprint card) with payment to Idaho State Police BCI, 700 S. Stratford Dr., Ste. 120, Meridian, ID 83642. Checks/money orders payable to Idaho State Police.
states.notes: Name-based form (Rev. 10/24/24): 'A $20 processing fee must be included.' Fingerprint-based check reported at $25 on the fingerprint form (not separately verified). Card payments add $1.00 plus 2.5%. BCI can notarize fingerprint-based results on request. Error-correction process not stated on the form.

states.agency: Illinois State Police (ISP), Bureau of Identification
states.check_name: Access and Review / Record Challenge
states.how: Go to any Illinois law enforcement agency, correctional facility, or licensed fingerprint vendor, complete the Access and Review form and be fingerprinted; the request goes to ISP, which sends your Illinois transcript back to that agency/vendor (within 60 days under 20 Ill. Adm. Code 1210).
states.notes: ISP fee schedule: 'Illinois Access and Review/Record Challenge - No Charge.' The agency or vendor taking fingerprints may charge up to its actual cost (may be waived). Record challenges use the same Access and Review process. Petitions to expunge/seal are also no charge at ISP; court order to expunge/seal $60.

states.agency: Indiana State Police (ISP), Criminal History Services / Central Records
states.check_name: State-Only Review Challenge Report (fingerprint-based); Limited Criminal History (name-based)
states.how: Review Challenge Report: get fingerprinted electronically through the state vendor (IDEMIA/IdentoGO) and request the State-Only Review Challenge Report. Limited Criminal History (name + DOB, Indiana only): online, by mail (money order), or in person at ISP Central Records, Indianapolis.
states.fingerprints: required for Review Challenge Report; not required for Limited Criminal History
states.notes: ISP fee schedule: State-Only Review Challenge Report - state fee $10.00 + fingerprint fee $11.95 = $21.95 total (schedule notes the fingerprint fee rose to $12.95, so total likely $22.95). Limited Criminal History: $7.00 by mail; $16.32 online ($7 + $9.32 online fee). Limited check shows only Indiana name/DOB matches and is charged even for 'No Records Found'. Fee schedule appears dated (2020); verify.

states.agency: Kansas Bureau of Investigation (KBI), Kansas Central Repository / Criminal History Records Section
states.check_name: Request for your own criminal history record (record review and possible challenge)
states.how: Mail a letter (KBI provides a sample letter) listing all names, DOBs and SSNs you've used, with an FD-258 applicant or FD-353 fingerprint card and payment to KBI, Attn: Kansas Central Repository, 1620 SW Tyler, Topeka, KS 66612-1837. Not available through the online name search.
states.notes: KBI sample letter: payment 'payable to the KBI Record Check Fee Fund for $45.00'; add $10 (total $55) to have the rap sheet notarized. A fingerprint request releases ALL information in your record, including juvenile records (only obtainable by fingerprint). KBI's public name-based online search shows only public info. KBI fees for agency fingerprint checks increased in 2024, so verify current amount. Kansas law prohibits employers from requiring you to obtain your own record.

states.agency: Kentucky State Police (KSP), Criminal Identification and Records Branch; also Administrative Office of the Courts (AOC) for court record reports
states.check_name: KSP Kentucky Name Based background check (own record review); AOC Criminal Record Report
states.how: KSP: mail or walk in with the KSP background check form and a $20 check or money order to KY State Treasurer; no fingerprints required. AOC: request a court-record-based Criminal Record Report online or by mail (form AOC-RU-004/005).
states.notes: KSP page: 'Kentucky - Name Based $20 check or money order made out to KY State Treasurer. Fingerprints not required'; mail takes about 10 business days. The AOC report ($25 per AOC form, not verified on current page) covers state district/circuit court cases and is often the record used for expungement eligibility. Correction process not stated on KSP page.

states.agency: Louisiana State Police (LSP), Bureau of Criminal Identification and Information (BCII)
states.check_name: Right to Review
states.how: Schedule a fingerprint appointment through the Louisiana Applicant Processing System (LAPS) at a local fingerprint site, pay there, and receive the report by mail (certified 'True Copy') or by secure email link. If unable to appear, mail the Right to Review Authorization and Disclosure forms with two FD-258 fingerprint cards and fee to LSP BCII, P.O. Box 66614, Box A-6, Baton Rouge, LA 70896.
states.notes: Under La. R.S. 15:588. LSP Right to Review Authorization form (revised 9/29/2020): $26.00 processing fee (required by mail or in person) plus $10.00 fingerprint fee if printed at LSP Headquarters. LSP page: since Dec 1, 2024 a $5 technology fee is added to all background check requests (so total likely $31 + fingerprinting). Form states the process gives you the opportunity to complete or challenge the accuracy of the information.

states.agency: Massachusetts Department of Criminal Justice Information Services (DCJIS)
states.check_name: Personal CORI (Criminal Offender Record Information) request via iCORI; CORI self-audit
states.how: Online through iCORI (register as 'Personal Self'; requires valid Massachusetts driver's license or ID), or by mail using the Personal CORI Request Form (notarized/ID proof) with cashier's check or money order payable to the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.
states.notes: mass.gov fee table: 'Personal CORI request $25 per request'; 'Indigent subject fee waiver $0' - submit the Affidavit of Indigency with the Personal Request Form. Self-audit (who has looked at your CORI) free once every 90 days. It is illegal for employers to require you to provide your own CORI. mass.gov has a 'How to correct a CORI' document (corrections go through the court/agency that created the entry). DCJIS FAQ says an updated iCORI system launched around October 20, 2026 - verify fees. mass.gov blocks automated fetch; fee from official page search snippet.

states.agency: Maryland Department of Public Safety and Correctional Services (DPSCS), Criminal Justice Information System (CJIS) Central Repository
states.check_name: Individual Review (Individual Background Check)
states.how: Maryland residents: get fingerprinted at any authorized fingerprinting location (or at the Central Repository) for an 'Individual Review'. Out-of-state: request a fingerprint card from CJIS Central Repository, P.O. Box 32708, Pikesville, MD 21282-2708, and return it with the CJIS 015 form and payment.
states.notes: COMAR 12.15.01.15: 'nonrefundable CHRI access fee of $18' for 'Individual review' (state only), plus $20 fingerprinting service fee only if the Central Repository does the fingerprinting (private vendors charge their own fees). COMAR fee chart lists 'Individual challenge' with no fee. Response within 10-15 days of receiving the fingerprint card. Payment rules have changed; check with CJIS (410-764-4501).

states.agency: Maine State Police, State Bureau of Identification (SBI)
states.check_name: Maine Criminal History Record and Juvenile Crime Information Request (online service)
states.how: Online at maine.gov/pcr with full name and date of birth (name-based; results immediate; notarized reports orderable online for +$10), or fingerprint-based by submitting fingerprints directly to SBI (results by mail).
states.notes: SBI FAQ: 'A thirty-one dollar ($31.00) fee ($21.00 for inforME subscribers in the state of Maine)'; fee charged regardless of results; no difference between name-based and fingerprint-based. Online check shows conviction and adjudication information; a positive match is only certain with fingerprints. Challenges via SBI directly.

states.agency: Michigan State Police (MSP), Criminal Justice Information Center (CJIC)
states.check_name: Fingerprint-based personal records check (personal review); ICHAT (Internet Criminal History Access Tool, name-based public records)
states.how: Fingerprint route: Michigan residents get printed by local law enforcement on a Michigan Applicant Fingerprint Card (RI-008) (out-of-state: FD-258), then mail the card with $30 money order/check payable to State of Michigan to MSP CJIC, P.O. Box 30266, Lansing, MI 48909-7766. Name route: ICHAT online search.
states.fingerprints: required for full personal record; not required for ICHAT
states.notes: MSP page: 'Submit the fingerprints and a $30.00 processing fee'; one certified/notarized original response (+$1 per extra original); allow 3-5 weeks. Fingerprint results include all record information, public and nonpublic. ICHAT name search is $10 (per MSP / MCL 28.273, not verified on fetched page) and shows only public records. To correct a Michigan entry, MSP lists a contact (msp-crd-crimhelp@michigan.gov); for FBI entries contact the contributing agency.

states.agency: Minnesota Bureau of Criminal Apprehension (BCA)
states.check_name: Data request by data subject (own criminal history for personal use); 'Self (Minnesota only)' background check for use by others
states.how: For personal use: submit a BCA data request (Data Request by Data Subject form via the GovQA portal, or bring form with photo ID to BCA, 1430 Maryland Ave E, St. Paul, or mail a notarized original). Public records also searchable on the Minnesota Public Criminal History website. For a copy to give to others: Self (Minnesota only) background check.
states.fingerprints: not required (BCA may require fingerprints to verify identity)
states.notes: BCA Data Access Policy: no cost to inspect your data at the BCA; copies of 100 or fewer black-and-white pages are free ($0.25/page above that). BCA fee page: 'Self (Minnesota only) - $8.00' for a background check record for use by others (housing, employment, licensing). Records sealed under Clean Slate/Cannabis Act can be obtained in full through a data request. Questioned Identity process for misuse of your name.

states.agency: Missouri State Highway Patrol (MSHP), Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Division
states.check_name: Personal Identifier (name-based) Search or Fingerprint Search via MACHS (Missouri Automated Criminal History Site)
states.how: Name-based: online through the MACHS Name Search Portal (credit card) or by mail with form SHP-158 and check/money order to 'State of Missouri - Criminal Record System Fund'. Fingerprint: schedule through the MACHS Fingerprint Search Portal with IDEMIA, or mail an FD-258 card.
states.notes: MSHP page: name-based search $16.00 per request (plus convenience fee online) - results are a 'possible match' showing open records only. Fingerprint state-only fee $20.00 plus IDEMIA fee (state check via IDEMIA about $35 total per MSHP page). Fingerprint results include closed records only where authorized. Notarized results +$5. Fingerprint processing 7-10 business days.

states.agency: Mississippi Department of Public Safety (MDPS), Criminal Information Center (CIC)
states.check_name: Name-Based Background Check (online, self-requested)
states.how: Online through the DPS Name-Based Background Check portal on ms.gov; only the person the record belongs to can initiate it; pay by credit/debit card.
states.notes: DPS portal lists $32.00 per request (per official page search result; page blocks automated fetch). May take up to 30 calendar days. CIC fingerprint-based record checks are also $32 under Mississippi Administrative Code. Questions: 601-933-2600. Correction process not stated.

states.agency: Montana Department of Justice, Division of Criminal Investigation, Criminal Records (Criminal History Records Program)
states.check_name: Criminal History Online Public Record Search (CHOPRS, name-based) / fingerprint-based state check
states.how: Online name-based search (CHOPRS) with name and DOB, paying by card or eCheck; by mail with a request form, check/money order and self-addressed stamped envelope; or fingerprint-based by mailing/bringing a fingerprint card to Montana Criminal Records, Helena (walk-in M-F 8:30-4:30).
states.notes: DOJ background checks page (per official-site search; page blocks automated fetch): online name-based search $20.00 each; mailed name-based $15.00; state-only fingerprint check $10.00. Name-based search shows only Montana public criminal history. Fees conflict with older DOJ schedules; confirm at (406) 444-3625. Correction process not found.

states.agency: North Carolina State Bureau of Investigation (SBI)
states.check_name: Right to Review (Personal Review; NC State fingerprint-based check)
states.how: Get fingerprinted on an FD-258 card, complete the 'Request for Access to Criminal History Record Information - Right to Review' form, and mail it with the fee to the SBI. All Right to Review requests must be submitted by mail.
states.notes: SBI Personal Review page: 'NC State Fingerprint-based Check - $14'. Response on SBI letterhead by U.S. mail, with any matching record attached; up to 20 business days. Fee waiver: include a claim and proof of indigence (e.g., notarized affidavit of indigence) per SBI instructions. Purpose is personal review to ensure the record is complete and accurate. SBI also links the FBI national check ($18).

states.agency: North Dakota Office of Attorney General, Bureau of Criminal Investigation (BCI)
states.check_name: Request for Criminal History Record Information (public request, form SFN 50744)
states.how: Mail the original signed form with fee (check or money order payable to 'ND Attorney General', no cash by mail) to BCI, or drop off at the Bismarck office (check, money order or exact cash). Name-based with SSN, or fingerprint-based if you include fingerprints taken by local law enforcement.
states.notes: ND AG page: 'Request for Criminal History Record Information - $15 fee.' Eligible non-profits can apply for a reduced $5 fee. Name-based search won't find records under a different name; fingerprint search will. About 7-10 business days. North Dakota records only. Correction process not stated.

states.agency: Nebraska State Patrol (NSP), Criminal Identification Division
states.check_name: Criminal History Record Request (Nebraska RAP sheet)
states.how: Online, in person at any NSP Troop Area office with the Criminal History Record Request form, or by mail to the Criminal Identification Division; name and DOB based.
states.notes: NSP page: 'You may request an online criminal history for a fee of $45.00'; same $45.00 in person or by mail (cashier's check, personal check or money order). The RAP sheet shows Nebraska arrests where the person was fingerprinted, and dispositions. Older admin code lists lower fees - outdated. Correction process not stated on page.

states.agency: New Hampshire Department of Safety, Division of State Police, Criminal Records Unit
states.check_name: Criminal History Record Information request (Form DSSP 256)
states.how: In person at the public counter, 33 Hazen Drive, Concord, NH 03305 with government photo ID (complete Section I only; credit cards accepted at counter), or by mail with DSSP 256 notarized (or signed before a Justice of the Peace) and a check payable to 'State of NH - Criminal Records'.
states.notes: DSSP 256 (rev. 06/2024) and Saf-C 5703: $25.00 per request, charged whether or not a record is found (per official form/rule; NHSP pages block automated fetch). RSA 106-B:14 gives the right to your own record for a fee. Arrest records (not just convictions) are released only if you specifically ask for them on the form. Challenges (Saf-C 5703.12): appear at the central repository, identify the inaccurate portion and give the correct version.

states.agency: New Jersey State Police (NJSP), Criminal Information Unit (CIU)
states.check_name: Personal Records Request (fingerprint-based NJ CHRI check; service code 2F1BJG, notarized version 2F1BH1)
states.how: Schedule a fingerprint appointment with IDEMIA/IdentoGO (uenroll.identogo.com or 1-877-503-5981) using the personal record service code, bring photo ID, pay at the site. Letter downloadable at njportal.com/NJSP/prr within 24-72 hours if no record; if a record is found, results are mailed. Out-of-state residents can use out-of-state IdentoGO sites (extra convenience fee).
states.notes: NJSP page (per official-site search; NJSP page did not load for direct fetch): fee $45.73 including $15.73 vendor fee and sales tax; card/ACH accepted; non-refundable; 90 days to download. CIU contact 609-882-2000 ext. 2302, CIU@njsp.gov. Correction process not found on page.

states.agency: New Mexico Department of Public Safety (DPS), Law Enforcement Records Bureau (LERB), State Central Repository for Criminal History
states.check_name: Arrest record information request (DPS Authorization for Release of Information)
states.how: Mail a legible, complete, notarized DPS Authorization for Release of Information form with original signature and a money order or cashier's check payable to 'New Mexico Department of Public Safety'. All adult arrest records are released with the proper release and payment.
states.fingerprints: not required (not stated on page; uses notarized authorization)
states.notes: DPS LERB page: 'The processing fee is $15.00 per record check in the form of a money order or cashier's check'. Repository holds NM arrests for felonies, misdemeanors punishable by 6+ months, and DWI, based on arrest fingerprint cards. Fingerprint-based checks available via NMAPS. Phone (505) 827-9181. Correction process not stated.

states.agency: Nevada Department of Public Safety, Records, Communications and Compliance Division (RCCD), Nevada Criminal History Repository
states.check_name: Request for Nevada Criminal History (Form DPS-006); Inspection of Record (DPS-008-I); Challenge (DPS-008-X)
states.how: Mail form DPS-006, one original FD-258 fingerprint card taken by a certified fingerprinting technician (sheriff, police, or private fingerprint agency), and payment to DPS RCCD. Only the subject of the record can request.
states.notes: DPS-006 (7/2023 rev): 'Payment in the amount $27.00 (US dollars), per applicant', money order or certified check payable to Nevada Department of Public Safety; no personal checks or cash. No fee for victims of sex trafficking (NRS 179.245). NRS 179A.100 gives the right to your own record. Challenges under NRS 179A.150 with form DPS-008-X plus statement, documents and fingerprint card. Nevada only - no FBI/other states.

states.agency: New York State Division of Criminal Justice Services (DCJS), Record Review Unit
states.check_name: Record Review (Request Your New York State Criminal History / personal rap sheet)
states.how: Schedule fingerprinting with IdentoGO using the DCJS Record Review service, get fingerprinted, and DCJS mails your response (generally 7-10 business days after the fingerprint transaction). You may request a suppressed or unsuppressed version (separate requests). Fee-waiver packets via RecordReview@dcjs.ny.gov or Records Review Unit, 80 South Swan Street, Albany, NY 12210.
states.notes: Fee could not be confirmed: DCJS site was unreachable for direct fetch, and official/secondary sources conflict ($50 DCJS record review fee per 9 NYCRR 6050.1 and older guides, plus an IdentoGO fingerprint processing fee shown variously as $13.50 or $17.50 effective 2/2/2026; older totals ~$60-62). DCJS offers a FEE WAIVER for those unable to pay - request the waiver packet by email/mail. You cannot request another person's record. Clean Slate sealing may not yet be reflected.

states.agency: Ohio Attorney General, Bureau of Criminal Investigation (BCI), Identification Division
states.check_name: Requesting Your Own Criminal Records (computerized criminal history)
states.how: Mail BCI your identifying info, a complete set of fingerprints, signed consent, and $22 payment; or submit fingerprints electronically at BCI offices (London, Boardman/Youngstown, Bowling Green) or through a local WebCheck provider (bring photo ID; vendor convenience fee may apply).
states.notes: Ohio AG page: 'business check, money order, or electronic payment in the amount of $22.00 made payable to the Treasurer of State of Ohio.' WebCheck locations add their own fees. Minors need a parent/guardian waiver. Challenging: gather proof and contact the agency responsible for the incorrect entry (often the sheriff, police department, or court); BCI does not keep court documents.

states.agency: Oklahoma State Bureau of Investigation (OSBI), Criminal History Reporting Unit
states.check_name: Criminal history background check via CHIRP (Criminal History Information Request Portal); Individual Request for Criminal History Record Inspection
states.how: Online through CHIRP (full name and DOB, up to 3 aliases free), or by mail/in person with the request form. To check accuracy of your own record, OAC 375:9-1-2 provides an Individual Request for Criminal History Record Inspection Form.
states.notes: OSBI page: 'Name-Based - $20.00; Fingerprint-Based - $25.00' (74 O.S. 150.9; increased from $15 effective Nov 1, 2026 under SB 1921). CHIRP adds a small online convenience fee. Results are Oklahoma only; arrests not fingerprinted aren't in the OSBI record.

states.agency: Oregon State Police (OSP), Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Division
states.check_name: Copy of Own Record
states.how: Complete the Copy of Own Record form, get fingerprinted on a hard-copy applicant card (OSP Salem HQ offers fingerprinting for $30, or local agency), and mail form, card and fee to OSP CJIS Division, Unit 11, P.O. Box 4395, Portland, OR 97208-4395. Results mailed only to you.
states.notes: OSP page: 'complete our form, provide your fingerprints, and pay a $33.00 fee.' Optional notarization $5. Previously submitted prints can't be reused; no electronic submission. Oregon records only. Review/challenge rights under OAR 257-010-0035.

states.agency: Pennsylvania State Police (PSP), Central Repository
states.check_name: Individual Access and Review (form SP 4-170); also PATCH individual criminal history check
states.how: Individual access and review: by mail only - download form SP 4-170, complete it and mail it with the fee. Alternative: an individual background check online at PATCH ($22) or by mail with form SP 4-164.
states.fingerprints: not stated on PSP page for access and review
states.notes: PSP page: 'Individual access and review... can only be requested by mail... The fee for this check is $20. It can't be notarized.' PATCH individual check $22 (+$5 notarization). PA Criminal History Record Information Act (18 Pa.C.S. 9151-9153): right to review, challenge, correct and appeal; agency must review a challenge within 60 days and bears the burden of proving accuracy; rejected challenges may be appealed to the Attorney General within 30 days. Checks cover Pennsylvania records only.

states.agency: Rhode Island Office of the Attorney General, Bureau of Criminal Identification (BCI)
states.check_name: State background check (BCI criminal history report)
states.how: In person, no appointment, at the BCI customer service center, 4 Howard Ave., Cranston, RI (8:30-4:30 M-F) with valid state or federal photo ID and card payment; mail option also referenced. Results for a state-only check are name/ID-based; national check requires fingerprints at BCI.
states.fingerprints: not required (state check); required for national check
states.notes: AG 'Get a background check' page (per official-site search; page blocks automated fetch): State background checks cost $5 (card fees apply); national check $45. Contact BCI 401-274-4400. Correction process not stated.

states.agency: South Carolina Law Enforcement Division (SLED)
states.check_name: SLED CATCH (Citizens Access to Criminal History) report
states.how: Online at catch.sled.sc.gov (card; $1 convenience fee plus, since July 1, 2026, a $1.43 service fee) or by mail (business/certified/cashier's check or money order; no personal checks or cash). Name + DOB 'starts with' match.
states.notes: SLED CATCH: 'A non-refundable fee of $25.00 will be charged for a South Carolina criminal records check.' Reduced $8 fee for qualifying charitable organizations (not individuals). Name-based only; SLED only does fingerprint checks when required by statute. South Carolina only. Page states subjects have a right to correct erroneous criminal records information.

states.agency: South Dakota Attorney General, Division of Criminal Investigation (DCI), Identification Section
states.check_name: Personal/State ONLY fingerprint background check
states.how: Get the DCI fingerprint card, have local police/sheriff take your fingerprints, and mail the card with signed authorization and a $30 check or money order (payable to Division of Criminal Investigation; no cash) to DCI.
states.notes: AG page: 'A check or money order for $30.00 must be sent along with the fingerprint card and signed authorization.' State + FBI check $50. Local agencies may charge for fingerprinting. No refunds. If never fingerprinted on arrest, DCI has no record. SDCL 23-5-12 lets any person examine criminal history information that refers to them, with written request and fingerprint identification.

states.agency: Tennessee Bureau of Investigation (TBI), Tennessee Open Records Information Services (TORIS)
states.check_name: General Public Tennessee Only background check (TORIS name-based); fingerprint-based check via IdentoGO
states.how: Name-based: online request form or by mail; results delivered electronically (valid email required). Fingerprint-based: through TBI's contractor IdentoGO (not local law enforcement).
states.notes: TBI page: 'General Public Tennessee Only $29 FINGERPRINTS NOT REQUIRED'. Fingerprint-based Tennessee-only check via IdentoGO listed at $23.90 (international adoption/state only category); TN & FBI applicant $37.15. Disputes: submit fingerprints with a letter stating you wish to dispute the record check findings (per TBI TORIS materials). TORIS phone 615-744-4057.

states.agency: Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS), Crime Records Service
states.check_name: Right of Review / Personal Review of Texas criminal history (fingerprint-based, via IdentoGO/FAST; service code 11FT12)
states.how: Schedule a fingerprint appointment with the DPS vendor (IdentoGO; Fingerprint Applicant Services of Texas) for personal review, get fingerprinted and pay at the appointment; out-of-state residents can enroll and mail hard fingerprint cards. DPS mails the record to the address on file within ten business days.
states.notes: 37 Tex. Admin. Code 27.1: 'An individual must pay the $15 Texas criminal history record information fee, and the $10 fingerprinting fee. The total $25 fee' (card, business check or money order; no personal checks or cash). Request expires 30 calendar days after submission. If you believe the record is incorrect or incomplete, the rule directs you to DPS's error resolution process (Crime Records Service). DPS's name-based public conviction database is separate.

states.agency: Utah Department of Public Safety, Bureau of Criminal Identification (BCI)
states.check_name: Right of Access (Utah Criminal Record)
states.how: Walk-in at BCI, 4315 South 2700 West, Suite 1300, Taylorsville, UT 84129 (fastest), at a Right of Access partner agency, or by mail with the Criminal History Record Application, photocopy of photo ID, fingerprints (in the box on the application or a 10-print card), and payment.
states.fingerprints: required (by mail - prints on application or card); walk-in identity verified at BCI
states.notes: BCI page: 'The fee for a Right of Access is $20.00. All processing fees are non-refundable' (raised from $15 on May 7, 2025). Only the person whose record it is can request it. Record contains only fingerprint-verified arrests. BCI has a separate 'Challenge Your Record' process (fee reported as $20, not verified).

states.agency: Virginia State Police (VSP), Central Criminal Records Exchange (CCRE)
states.check_name: Criminal History Record Name Search Request (Form SP-167)
states.how: Complete Form SP-167 (generated online, printed and mailed; one form per request). For your own record only Section 1 is needed, with your notarized signature (VSP also offers Remote Online Notary for an extra fee). Optionally attach a fingerprint card for a fingerprint-supported search. Mail to CCRE with payment.
states.notes: VSP SP-167 form/instructions: '$15.00 CRIMINAL HISTORY SEARCH'. Without fingerprints the search returns Virginia convictions only. Online-notary surcharge shown as $15 or $25 in different VSP materials. Processing about 15-20 business days. Inaccurate records can be challenged through the CCRE record challenge process. Contact Background_Checks@vsp.virginia.gov.

states.agency: Vermont Department of Public Safety, Vermont Crime Information Center (VCIC)
states.check_name: Review of your own record at VCIC; Criminal Convictions Records Request (online, name-based)
states.how: Review your own record free in person at VCIC (Waterbury) with identification; copies are charged. Online conviction record check through the DPS Criminal Convictions Records Request Service (name and DOB).
states.notes: 20 V.S.A. 2063: name/DOB record check costs $30.00; 'Requests made by individuals to review their own record at the Vermont Crime Information Center' are exempt from the fee, but copies of the record are not exempt. So viewing is FREE in person; a copy is $30. Online service shows convictions only and is non-refundable. Certified copies require an in-person visit. VCIC (802) 241-5320.

states.agency: Washington State Patrol (WSP), Identification and Criminal History Section / Criminal History Records Section
states.check_name: Record Review (copy of your non-conviction CHRI by fingerprint); Non-Conviction Record Review in person; WATCH (Washington Access to Criminal History, conviction-only name search)
states.how: By mail: send a fingerprint card and $12 to WSP Identification and Background Check Section, PO Box 42633, Olympia, WA 98504-2633; your complete record is returned to the address on the card for personal use. In person: free record review at the WSP Criminal History Records Section (fingerprints taken for ID; up to 30 minutes). Online: WATCH name search ($11) shows conviction records only.
states.fingerprints: required for record review; not required for WATCH
states.notes: WSP page: 'To obtain a completed record review, send a fingerprint card and $12.00'; in-person non-conviction record review 'There is no fee for this service'. WATCH: $11 per name search, $15 notarized letter; free thumbprint verification of a WATCH result. Incarcerated people can request review through the facility (RECORD REVIEW/CHALLENGE). Non-conviction info may be deleted on request under RCW 10.97.060.

states.agency: Wisconsin Department of Justice (DOJ), Crime Information Bureau (CIB)
states.check_name: WORCS (Wisconsin Online Record Check System) name-based record check; Criminal History Challenge (form DJ-LE-247)
states.how: Anyone may request adult criminal history online through WORCS (card payment) or by mail with form DJ-LE-250. To challenge a record (e.g., mistaken identity), submit an FD-258 fingerprint card taken by law enforcement with the Wisconsin Criminal History Challenge Form DJ-LE-247.
states.fingerprints: not required for WORCS; required for a challenge
states.notes: Wis. Stat. 165.82 (as reproduced on DOJ form DJ-LE-250, rev. 10/24): $7.00 per name-based record check; $5 surcharge if a paper copy is required. Challenges: DOJ page says 'There is no fee from the Wisconsin Department of Justice to request a challenge' (local fingerprinting fees may apply); successful challengers get a WiUPIN number. DOJ advises challenging within 6 months of receiving the record. WORCS checkout page not verified directly.

states.agency: West Virginia State Police (WVSP), Criminal Identification Bureau / Criminal History Section
states.check_name: Criminal history record review / challenge (Form WVSP-136A)
states.how: WVSP-136A is used to review/challenge a record: mail the form with fingerprints and fee (check or money order payable to Superintendent of the West Virginia State Police) to WVSP Criminal History Section, 701 Jefferson Road, South Charleston, WV 25309. Fingerprint-based repository.
states.notes: Could not confirm on an official WVSP page a fee for simply obtaining a copy of your own record. Agency-hosted copies of form WVSP-136A (rev. 05/17) reportedly list a $20.00 processing fee for a record challenge/review (not verified directly). WVSP says the WV repository is biometric (fingerprint) based, not name-based. W. Va. Code 15-2C-6 authorizes user charges. WVSP website did not load.

states.agency: Wyoming Division of Criminal Investigation (DCI), Criminal Records Unit
states.check_name: Voluntary record check (on yourself; Wyoming + Western Identification Network states)
states.how: Submit an applicant fingerprint card with the statutory fee (money order, cashier's/certified/business check, or card) to DCI. DCI fingerprinting available for $5.
states.notes: DCI FAQ: 'For most applicants, the fee is $15 for the state of Wyoming which includes the Western Identification Network criminal history check' (WIN: AK, ID, MT, NV, OR, UT, WA). FBI check $24 extra only where statute allows; otherwise go to FBI directly. Usually done within 2 weeks (up to 5-6). Corrections: Wyo. Stat. 7-19-109 (Wyoming arrests only).
